baseMillis.description:
The base delay in milliseconds.
The nth sleep time is approximately calculated as [baseMillis * exponent ^ n] with jitter.
If both baseMillis and initialMillis are provided, baseMillis takes priority.

exponent.description:
The exponent to multiply the prior wait time in generating the next.
Note that 1.0 will generate a linear wait time.
Note that 2.0 will double the maximum possible wait each time.

initialMillis.description: The base delay in milliseconds, used to set the base of the series. It does not send an 'initial' wait time.

jitter.description: Determines the algorithm used to calculate jitter. If noJitter is set to true, jitter will always be set to NONE.

maxRetry.description:
The maximum number of values to generate, representing the maximum number of retries in the sequence.
If unset, an infinite number of values will be generated.

maxTotalMillis.description:
The maximum total time of all retries to generate. If unset, an infinite total time of values will be generated.
Note that regardless of the total time, at least one value will be generated.

maxSleepMillis.description: The maximum number of milliseconds for each sleep iteration.  If not set, no limit will be imposed.

minMillis.description: The minimum time guaranteed each iteration.

noJitter.description:
If for some reason you do not want jitter (not recommended) turn it off by setting this to true.
Then for each step (if no maximums are exceeded) you will wait exactly initialMillis * (exponent ^ attempt)
instead of the default which is randomly chosen on a uniform distribution between 0 and
initialMillis * (exponent ^ attempt). This default is the "Full Jitter" recommended strategy for making the
fewest number of overall calls described by the {@link
https://www.awsarchitectureblog.com/2015/03/backoff.html AWS Architecture Blog}.

title:
An exponential back-off sequence generator. This has the property of a predictable exponential
growth curve defined by initialMillis * (exponent ^ attempt), but with actual
wait times randomly distributed between 0 and this curve.
name: ExponentialBackoff
